groups.defect: error-invalid-multivalued-size in the React admin-ui and account-ui English bundles was switched from i18next {{n}} placeholders to Java MessageFormat {n}/choice syntax. i18next does not interpolate it, so users see the raw template.

answer.reasoning: All five suggestions describe the same defect: the same key in the i18next-rendered React bundles now uses MessageFormat syntax that i18next cannot interpolate. Four point at line 3138 of the admin-ui file and one points at line 188 of the account-ui file. Three of the admin-ui ones also name the account-ui line. The same copy-pasted change sits in two separate files, and each file needs its own edit. That makes this a systemic pattern rather than one fix at one place, so a unified comment is needed to cover both files. Both judges agree on the membership; they differ only on the kind.
